summary: Protected PR4588 supplies the CPython backing-allocation companion and protected PR4590 consumes it as one separate source-scoped ledger group. At the real synchronous sixth backend readback, nine exact built-in backend bytearrays and the decoder bytearray join their identities, contents and logical lengths to the original same-cut census. bytearray.__alloc__ reads allocated buffer bytes directly, including trailing byte and overallocation; len is a different quantity. The qualified source vector has ten mutually distinct arrays: stable phase capacities 1142/973/831/918/832/992, old 832, candidate 992, readback 992 and decoder 318. This totals 8,822 selected backing-capacity bytes versus 8,790 separate logical bytes (backend 8,504 versus 8,495; decoder 318 versus 295). Source qualification reports this vector on local CPython 3.14.8 and hosted CPython 3.12.3; it is not a portable constant or a value inferred from length. The consumer checks the producer hash, reruns its actual pure journey, binds implementation/version/build and every role identity/type/length/capacity, and fails visibly on changed vectors instead of regenerating inputs. Temporary-to-stable identity transfers count once; frozen inputs and inspection frames are harness ownership, not extra selected allocations. Unsupported runtime/capability or bytearray subclasses refuse without skip, len or getsizeof fallback. Equal-length substitution, false alias, missing/extra roles, forged length/capacity, content, ownership, source and scope drift controls exercise rejection. The consumer preserves 205 observations, 16 aliases and 10 obligations as exact prefixes with canonical digests/drift controls, then appends ten capacity observations and one obligation: 215 observations, 16 aliases, 11 obligations and 14 separate groups. The new group uses topology python-terminal-backing-capacity-controlled, run pr4588-capacity-source-witness and cut sixth-readback-selected-value-graphs; these are source-witness labels, not authenticated execution IDs. It records capacity only, with null logical subtotal and physical lower bound. Matching roles or stages cannot join older Python/managed runs; aliases, group collapse and logical-plus-capacity double counting refuse under the unchanged parser. No cross-run total, simultaneous peak, complete population or physical memory/fit follows. Even synthetic capacity beyond the existing policy cap leaves fit unproved/admission false. This finding selects no cap and does not establish later CAP-02 acceptance. Object headers, allocator rounding, resident memory, unselected/transient/parser/encoder/stream/caller/failure/concurrency/restart and other populations remain uncounted. No release/zeroization, installed/native/barrier/clock/custody or original-operation acceptance follows. Original .103 remains attempted-unknown/unreplayed and .104 held. This supplements github/managed-held-cut-backing-consumer and github/python-representation-copy-census without replacing their separate source cuts.
title: CPython source witness separates selected bytearray capacity from logical bytes and physical fit
